name: 80020 · Broomfield, CO
findings: ZIP 80020 (Broomfield) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80020 (Broomfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
